decisions.reason: Product A has its own web page and is close to the firm's established offer, indicating visible commitment and substantial sunk costs, so management will likely keep it.
Although distant from the established offer, Product B is presented on its own page, creating public commitment and justification pressure that makes dropping less likely.
Product C has a dedicated page and is close to the firm's core offer, indicating strong public commitment and investment, so escalation favors keeping it.
Product D's mere mention on the website signals weak public commitment and limited investment, so with little sunk cost and nothing to justify, management is more inclined to drop it.
